title: How Amazon pushes employees to integrate AI across their workload despite their concerns that the company's "half-baked" tools are creating more work (Varsha Bansal/The Guardian)
summary: Varsha Bansal / The Guardian: How Amazon pushes employees to integrate AI across their workload despite their concerns that the company's “half-baked” tools are creating more work — Corporate employees said Amazon's race to roll out AI is leading to surveillance, slop and ‘more work for everyone’.
contentText:
Varsha Bansal / The Guardian :

How Amazon pushes employees to integrate AI across their workload despite their concerns that the company's “half-baked” tools are creating more work   —  Corporate employees said Amazon's race to roll out AI is leading to surveillance, slop and ‘more work for everyone’.
